summary: The PR addresses the issue of printing a traceback for unrecognized options but introduces a new method of handling errors which may not be consistent with the rest of the project.

issues.description: The use of `_arg_parser.error` might not align with how other errors are handled in Pylint, potentially causing inconsistency in error reporting.
There are no additional tests to verify that the new error handling does not introduce any regressions or unexpected behavior.
